note: MA DCR state park in the northern Berkshires beside Mausert's Pond (swimming beach, non-motorized boating, 3-mile Pond Loop trail). Black bears visit: food lockers at every site. One-way wooded loop that is tight for big rigs; nearest dump station is at Savoy Mountain SF. --Claude

flags: Phone missing: Clarksburg State Park (413) 664-8345 (mass.gov and RA 'Campground Phone Number').

Criteria (rig length, keep suggested): mass.gov says 'Campsites accommodate tents, pop-up trailer and small RV.' This wording is specific to the Clarksburg page. RA's own site catalog lists 7 back-in sites rated 23-35 ft (sites 20 25 ft, 31 23 ft, 35 26 ft, 22/36/45/46 35 ft) and the RA description says 'many of which are large enough to accommodate an RV', so a 23-ft rig fits on 7 of 45 sites. I did not find a recent camper review from a 23-ft+ rig.

Waterfront re-audit lead (stored not waterfront; not changed): mass.gov says 'Come camp along the edge of Mausert's Pond'. RA tags no campsite Near Water (only the pavilion), and on imagery the loop roads under the canopy sit roughly 100-150 m back from the south shore through woods.

Pin: stored 42.7344,-73.0762 is in woods on the pond's SE shore, ~280 m east of where the campground loop roads show under the canopy (about 42.7336,-73.0795; RA GPS 42.73361,-73.08056). Suggest 42.7336,-73.0795.
